extracted.name: Shrimp Salsa
extracted.description: Shrimp, tomatoes, red onion, cilantro, and lime juice combine for a unique and refreshing chunky salsa perfect for scooping up with tortilla chips.
instruction_lines: Stir shrimp, tomatoes, onion, cilantro, lime juice, salt, pepper, and garlic together in a large glass bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until the flavors combine, at least 1 hour. Serve cold.
